####################################################################################################
Purpose of script: To check the model amplitude and phase of the best models and plot it 
####################################################################################################

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
source("../00_dirs.R")
theme_set(theme_classic() + theme(strip.background = element_blank()))
```

# Define main analyses 
```{r}
pat_sel <- c("rota", "hav", "hbv", "dipht", "tetan", "pertuwpt", "ipv1", 
             "hib", "menc", "strep04", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "vzv")
```

# Read in data 
```{r}
# Read best model
waic_best <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/modres/all_waicbest.rds"))
waiccomb_best <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_waiccombbest.rds"))
waic_best_all <- bind_rows(waiccomb_best, waic_best)

# Read in data gaps
all_datagaps <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_datagaps.rds")) 
all_datagapssim <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_datagapssim.rds")) 

all_samplescosine <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$modres}/all_samplescosine.rds")) %>%
  left_join(all_datagapssim, by = join_by(pat, mod, reg, clu, dat)) %>%
  mutate(pat_tidy = if_else(pat_tidy == "Diphteria", "Diphtheria", pat_tidy))
```

# Exploratory plots ================================================================================

# Summary statistics of the phase: 
```{r}
all_samplescosine %>%
  filter(mod %in%  waic_best$mod_best, pat %in% pat_sel, dat == "s08", 
         included == TRUE, clu == "1_Temperate") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sam_phi)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 52) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = sam_phi_mean), color = "red") +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = sam_phi_median), color = "yellow") +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = sam_phi_ci95lo), color = "limegreen") + 
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = sam_phi_ci95up), color = "limegreen") + 
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = sam_phi_min), color = "grey") + 
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = sam_phi_max), color = "grey") +
    facet_wrap(~pat, scales = "free_y")
```

# Summary statistics of the phase: 
```{r}
all_samplescosine %>%
  filter(mod %in% waic_best$mod_best, pat %in% pat_sel, dat == "s08", 
         included == TRUE, clu == "1_Temperate") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sam_amp)) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), color = "blue", linetype = "dotted") + 
    geom_histogram(bins = 52) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = sam_amp_mean), color = "red") +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = sam_amp_median), color = "yellow") +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = sam_amp_ci95lo), color = "limegreen") + 
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = sam_amp_ci95up), color = "limegreen") + 
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = sam_amp_min), color = "grey") + 
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = sam_amp_max), color = "grey") +
    facet_wrap(~pat, scales = "free")
```

# Figure 3 =========================================================================================

# Prepare data for the phase plot: 
```{r}
datpl_phi <- all_samplescosine %>%
  # Filter the region and pathogens
  filter(mod %in% waic_best_all$mod_best, included == TRUE | dat %in% c("se2_s08")) %>%
  # Round the phase (from 0 to 52) and create dummy shifted for organizing the plots
  group_by(mod, pat, clu, clu_tidy, dat) %>%
  mutate(sam_phi = round(sam_phi),
         phi_mean_shift = (phi_mean + 3) %% 52) %>%
  # Obtain proportion of samples for each phase (from 0 to 52) and complete with 0s
  group_by(across(-c(sam_no, int, p_cos, p_sin, sam_amp, sam_amp_ls, mu_ns))) %>%
  summarise(tot = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(across(-c(tot, sam_phi))) %>%
  complete(sam_phi = 0:52, fill = list(tot = 0)) %>%
  group_by(across(-c(tot, sam_phi))) %>%
  mutate(tot = tot/sum(tot)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Summary of phase values 
datpl_phisumm <- distinct(datpl_phi, across(-c(tot, sam_phi))) %>%
  mutate(sam_phi_ci95lo1 = sam_phi_ci95lo,
         sam_phi_ci95up1 = case_when(sam_phi_ci95lo >= sam_phi_ci95up ~ 52,
                                     .default = sam_phi_ci95up),
         sam_phi_ci95lo2 = case_when(sam_phi_ci95lo >= sam_phi_ci95up ~ 0),
         sam_phi_ci95up2 = case_when(sam_phi_ci95lo >= sam_phi_ci95up ~ sam_phi_ci95up),
         sam_phi_ci95lenght = case_when(is.na(sam_phi_ci95lo2) ~ (sam_phi_ci95up1 - sam_phi_ci95lo1),
                                        !is.na(sam_phi_ci95lo2) ~ (sam_phi_ci95up1 - sam_phi_ci95lo1) + 
                                          (sam_phi_ci95up2 - sam_phi_ci95lo2))) %>%
  mutate(sam_phi_ci95up1 = case_when(sam_phi_ci95lo >= sam_phi_ci95up ~ 52.5,
                                     .default = sam_phi_ci95up),
         sam_phi_ci95lo2 = case_when(sam_phi_ci95lo >= sam_phi_ci95up ~ -0.5))
saveRDS(datpl_phisumm, file = glue("{dirs$modres}/wbest_phisumm.rds"))
```

# Prepare data for the amplitude plot: 
```{r}
datpl_amp <- all_samplescosine %>%
  # Filter the region and pathogens
  filter(mod %in% waic_best_all$mod_best, included == TRUE | dat %in% c("se2_s08")) %>%
  # Create dummy shifted for organizing the plots
  group_by(mod, pat, clu, clu_tidy, dat) %>%
  mutate(phi_mean_shift = (phi_mean + 3) %% 52)

# Summary of phase values 
datpl_ampsumm <- distinct(datpl_amp, across(-c(sam_no, p_cos, p_sin, int, sam_amp, sam_amp_ls, sam_phi, mu_ns))) %>%
    mutate(sam_phi_ci95lo1 = sam_phi_ci95lo,
           sam_phi_ci95up1 = case_when(sam_phi_ci95lo >= sam_phi_ci95up ~ 52,
                                       .default = sam_phi_ci95up),
           sam_phi_ci95lo2 = case_when(sam_phi_ci95lo >= sam_phi_ci95up ~ 0),
           sam_phi_ci95up2 = case_when(sam_phi_ci95lo >= sam_phi_ci95up ~ sam_phi_ci95up),
           sam_phi_ci95lenght = case_when(is.na(sam_phi_ci95lo2) ~ (sam_phi_ci95up1 - sam_phi_ci95lo1),
                                          !is.na(sam_phi_ci95lo2) ~ (sam_phi_ci95up1 - sam_phi_ci95lo1) + 
                                            (sam_phi_ci95up2 - sam_phi_ci95lo2))) %>%
    mutate(sam_phi_ci95up1 = case_when(sam_phi_ci95lo >= sam_phi_ci95up ~ 52.5,
                                      .default = sam_phi_ci95up),
          sam_phi_ci95lo2 = case_when(sam_phi_ci95lo >= sam_phi_ci95up ~ -0.5))
saveRDS(datpl_ampsumm, file = glue("{dirs$modres}/wbest_ampsumm.rds"))

datpl_ampsumm %>%
  filter(pat == "vzv") %>%
  select(clu, sam_amp_mean, sam_phi_mean)
```

# Prepare data for the samples plot: 
```{r}
datpl_sam <- all_samplescosine %>%
  filter(mod %in% waic_best_all$mod_best, included == TRUE | dat %in% c("se2_s08"), sam_no <= 100) %>%
  crossing(vac_week_v1 = seq(from = 0, to = 2*pi, length = 53)) %>%
  mutate(sam_estimate = exp(int + p_cos*cos(vac_week_v1) + p_sin*sin(vac_week_v1)) / mu_ns,
         vac_week_v1 = round((52*vac_week_v1)/(2*pi))) %>%
  left_join(distinct(datpl_ampsumm, mod, pat, imm_name, reg, clu, phi_mean_shift),
            by = join_by(pat, mod, reg, clu, imm_name, clu_tidy, dat)) %>%
  left_join(distinct(all_datagaps, mod, clu, imm_name, vac_week_v1, tot), 
            by = join_by(mod, clu, imm_name, vac_week_v1))

datpl_sam_rug <- datpl_sam %>% 
  distinct(mod, vac_week_v1, tot, clu_tidy, pat, dat, pat_tidy, phi_mean, phi_mean_shift) %>%
  mutate(vac_week_v1 = case_when(!is.na(tot) ~ vac_week_v1)) 

# Save the data for the plot
saveRDS(datpl_sam, file = glue("{dirs$modres}/asel_samplespl.rds"))
saveRDS(datpl_sam_rug, file = glue("{dirs$modres}/asel_samplerugspl.rds"))
```

# Figure 3 =========================================================================================

# Main analyses
```{r}
fig3_l <- list()

# Plot phase
fig3_l$phi <- datpl_phi %>%
  filter(pat %in% pat_sel, mod %in% waic_best$mod_best, dat == "s08") %>%
  select(-clu_tidy) %>%
  left_join(tidy_names_clu) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sam_phi, y = reorder(pat_tidy, -phi_mean_shift), fill = phi_mean)) +
  geom_tile(aes(alpha = tot), color = "white") + 
  geom_point(data = filter(datpl_phisumm, pat %in% pat_sel, mod %in% waic_best$mod_best, dat == "s08"), 
             aes(x = sam_phi_median), size = 0.5) + 
  geom_segment(data = filter(datpl_phisumm, pat %in% pat_sel, mod %in% waic_best$mod_best, dat == "s08"), 
               aes(x = sam_phi_ci95lo1, xend = sam_phi_ci95up1), size = 0.4) + 
  geom_segment(data = filter(datpl_phisumm, pat %in% pat_sel, mod %in% waic_best$mod_best, dat == "s08"), 
               aes(x = sam_phi_ci95lo2, xend = sam_phi_ci95up2), size = 0.4) + 
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 53), linewidth = 1) + 
  facet_nested(clu_tidy~., space = "free", scales = "free") + 
  scale_alpha_continuous("Proportion of phases", na.value = 0, range = c(0.01, 1),
                         breaks = c(0.01, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn("Peak timing", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(0,52),
                       colours = c(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C"),
                                   rev(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C")))) +
  scale_x_continuous("Peak timing", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_y_discrete("") + 
  guides(alpha = guide_legend(order = 1, theme = theme(legend.text.position = "bottom",
                                                       legend.key.width  = unit(0.37/16, "npc"),
                                                       legend.key.height = unit(0.005, "npc"))), 
         fill = guide_colorbar(order = 2, theme = theme(legend.key.width  = unit(0.37, "npc"),
                                                        legend.key.height = unit(0.005, "npc")))) + 
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.justification = "right",
        legend.box = "vertical",
        legend.box.just = "right")

# Plot amplitude
fig3_l$amp <- datpl_amp %>%
  filter(pat %in% pat_sel, mod %in% waic_best$mod_best, dat == "s08") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sam_amp*100, y = reorder(pat_tidy, -phi_mean_shift))) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), color = "grey", linetype = "dotted") + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.01, shape = "|", size = 4, color = "grey30") + 
  geom_point(data = filter(datpl_ampsumm, pat %in% pat_sel, mod %in% waic_best$mod_best, dat == "s08"), 
             aes(x = sam_amp_median*100), size = 0.5, color = "black") + 
  geom_segment(data = filter(datpl_ampsumm, pat %in% pat_sel, mod %in% waic_best$mod_best, dat == "s08"),
               aes(x = sam_amp_ci95lo*100, xend = sam_amp_ci95up*100), 
               size = 0.4, color = "black") + 
  scale_x_continuous("Amplitude (%)") + 
  scale_y_discrete("") + 
  facet_grid(clu_tidy~., space = "free", scales = "free") + 
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0),
        axis.title.y = element_blank())

# Plot samples 
fig3_l$sam <- datpl_sam %>%
  filter(pat %in% pat_sel, mod %in% waic_best$mod_best, dat == "s08") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = vac_week_v1, y = sam_estimate, group = sam_no, color = phi_mean)) + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.1) + 
  scale_x_continuous("Week of vaccination", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(1,52), expand = c(0,0)) + 
  scale_y_continuous("Conditional effect", expand = c(0.2,0)) + 
  scale_color_gradientn("Peak timing", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(0,52), 
                        colours = c(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C"), 
                                    rev(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C"))),
                        guide = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5, barheight = 0.8)) +
  geom_point(data = filter(datpl_sam_rug, pat %in% pat_sel, mod %in% waic_best$mod_best, dat == "s08"),
             aes(y = -Inf), group = 1, shape = "|", size = 3) +
  ggh4x::facet_nested_wrap(~clu_tidy+reorder(pat_tidy, phi_mean_shift), scales = "free_y", nest_line = TRUE,
                           solo_line = TRUE, ncol = 7) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Bring plots together
fig3 <- (fig3_l$amp + theme(strip.text.y = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank()) + 
  fig3_l$phi + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank())) / fig3_l$sam

# Save the plot
ggsave(fig3, file = "../_figures/fig3.pdf", width = 10, height = 12)
```

# Supplementary figure: extra pathogens ============================================================
```{r}
waic_extrapath <- bind_rows(waiccomb_best, waic_best) %>%
  group_by(pat, dat) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  filter(!(pat %in% c("rota", "hav", "hbv", "dipht", "tetan", "pertuwpt", 
                  "hib", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "vzv")))
 
supfig7_l <- list()
# Plot the phase 
supfig7_l$phi <- datpl_phi %>%
  filter(dat == "s08", mod %in% waic_extrapath$mod_best) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sam_phi, y = pat_tidy, fill = phi_mean)) +
  geom_tile(aes(alpha = tot), color = "white") + 
  geom_point(data = filter(datpl_phisumm, dat == "s08", mod %in% waic_extrapath$mod_best), 
             aes(x = sam_phi_median), size = 0.5) + 
  geom_segment(data = filter(datpl_phisumm, dat == "s08", mod %in% waic_extrapath$mod_best), 
               aes(x = sam_phi_ci95lo1, xend = sam_phi_ci95up1), size = 0.4) + 
  geom_segment(data = filter(datpl_phisumm, dat == "s08", mod %in% waic_extrapath$mod_best), 
               aes(x = sam_phi_ci95lo2, xend = sam_phi_ci95up2), size = 0.4) + 
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 53), linewidth = 1) + 
  facet_nested(clu_tidy~., space = "free", scales = "free") + 
  scale_alpha_continuous("Proportion of phases", na.value = 0, range = c(0.01, 1),
                         breaks = c(0.01, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3)) +
  scale_fill_gradientn("Peak timing", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(0,52),
                       colours = c(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C"),
                                   rev(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C")))) +
  scale_x_continuous("Peak timing", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), expand = c(0,0)) +
  scale_y_discrete("") + 
  guides(alpha = guide_legend(order = 1, theme = theme(legend.text.position = "bottom",
                                                       legend.key.width  = unit(0.37/16, "npc"),
                                                       legend.key.height = unit(0.005, "npc"))), 
         fill = guide_colorbar(order = 2, theme = theme(legend.key.width  = unit(0.37, "npc"),
                                                        legend.key.height = unit(0.005, "npc")))) + 
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.justification = "right",
        legend.box = "vertical",
        legend.box.just = "right")

# Plot amplitude
supfig7_l$amp <- datpl_amp %>%
  filter(dat == "s08", mod %in% waic_extrapath$mod_best) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sam_amp*100, y = pat_tidy)) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0), color = "grey", linetype = "dotted") + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.01, shape = "|", size = 4, color = "grey30") + 
  geom_point(data = filter(datpl_ampsumm, dat == "s08", mod %in% waic_extrapath$mod_best), 
             aes(x = sam_amp_median*100), size = 0.5, color = "black") + 
  geom_segment(data = filter(datpl_ampsumm, dat == "s08", mod %in% waic_extrapath$mod_best),
               aes(x = sam_amp_ci95lo*100, xend = sam_amp_ci95up*100), 
               size = 0.4, color = "black") + 
  scale_x_continuous("Amplitude (%)") + 
  scale_y_discrete("") + 
  facet_grid(clu_tidy~., space = "free", scales = "free") + 
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0))

# Plot samples 
supfig7_l$sam <- datpl_sam %>%
  filter(dat == "s08", mod %in% waic_extrapath$mod_best) %>%
  left_join(distinct(waiccomb_best, dat, pat, patcomb, patcomb_tidy), by = join_by(pat, dat)) %>%
  mutate(sam_fil = if_else(patcomb == "ipv", 50, 20)) %>%
  filter(sam_no <= sam_fil) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = vac_week_v1, y = sam_estimate, group = paste0(pat, sam_no), color = phi_mean)) + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.1) + 
  scale_x_continuous("Week of vaccination", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(1,52), expand = c(0,0)) + 
  scale_y_continuous("Conditional effect", expand = c(0.2,0)) + 
  scale_color_gradientn("Peak timing", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(0,52), 
                        colours = c(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C"), 
                                    rev(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C"))),
                        guide = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5, barheight = 0.8)) +
  geom_point(data = filter(datpl_sam_rug, dat == "s08", mod %in% waic_extrapath$mod_best) %>%
               left_join(distinct(waiccomb_best, dat, pat, patcomb, patcomb_tidy), by = join_by(pat, dat)) %>%
               mutate(clu_tidy = droplevels(clu_tidy)),
             aes(y = -Inf), group = 1, shape = "|", size = 3) +
  ggh4x::facet_nested_wrap(~clu_tidy+patcomb_tidy, scales = "free_y", nest_line = TRUE,
                           solo_line = TRUE, ncol = 6) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Bring plots together
supfig7 <-  (
  supfig7_l$amp +
    theme(strip.text.y = element_blank(),
          axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
  supfig7_l$phi +
    theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y  = element_blank())
) /
  supfig7_l$sam +
  plot_layout(heights = c(4, 1))

# Save the plot
ggsave(supfig7, file = "../_figures/figsup7.pdf", width = 10, height = 10)
```

  scale_x_continuous("Week of vaccination", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(1,52), expand = c(0,0)) + 
  scale_y_continuous("Conditional effect", expand = c(0.2,0)) + 
  scale_color_gradientn("Peak timing", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(0,52), 
                        colours = c(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C"), 
                                    rev(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C"))),
                        guide = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5, barheight = 0.8)) +
  geom_point(data = filter(datpl_sam_rug, dat == "semeth_s08", mod %in% waic_extrapath$mod_best) %>%
          left_join(distinct(waiccomb_best, dat, pat, patcomb, patcomb_tidy), by = join_by(pat, dat)) %>%
                      mutate(patcomb_tidy = ifelse(pat == "vzv", "VZV", patcomb_tidy)), 
             aes(y = -Inf), group = 1, shape = "|", size = 3) +
  ggh4x::facet_nested_wrap(~clu_tidy+patcomb_tidy, scales = "free_y", nest_line = TRUE,
                           solo_line = TRUE, ncol = 6) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Bring plots together
supfig10 <-  (
  supfig10_l$amp +
    theme(strip.text.y = element_blank(),
          axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
  supfig10_l$phi +
    theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y  = element_blank())
) /
  supfig10_l$sam +
  plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1))

# Save the plot
ggsave(supfig10, file = "../_figures/figsup10.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)
